title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.upgrade (npm)
description: The npm package 'statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.upgrade' is identified as malicious. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, with potential unauthorized control by an outside entity. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system is recommended. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components.
